items.title: Solana Changelog: Mainnet raises block limits to 100M CUs
items.whyYouShouldCare: Increasing block limits to 100 million compute units enhances Solana's capacity, potentially improving transaction speed and attracting more developers and users to the network.

items.title: Overview of Institutional Real World Assets on Solana
items.whyYouShouldCare: Institutional interest in real-world assets on Solana could drive liquidity and expand the ecosystem, positioning SOL as a viable platform for asset tokenization.

items.title: Binance founder CZ calls for wallet diversification after $70 million Coldcard exploit
items.whyYouShouldCare: Calls for wallet diversification highlight security risks in the crypto space, which could impact user confidence and the overall usage of Solana's ecosystem.
